name: Everything Upgrade Tree
desc:
Welcome to Everything Upgrade Tree, also known as EUT - an incremental, which grows larger and larger the further you progress. Discover interesting mechanics such as Cards, Astronomy, Mining or even literal brainrot.
Please note that this game is tailored towards an "idle game" audience.

⚠️This game has flashing imagery and epileptic content. Play at your own risk.
⚠️Exploits, macros, using multiple accounts, and similar strategies are prohibited. Being caught results in an unappealable ban (Autoclickers that only click in one spot are allowed)
